title: Consolidate load profiles and add traffic snapshot replayer for deterministic perf runs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Background: Over the past 18 months we accumulated multiple ad-hoc synthetic load profiles (k6 scripts, python runners, and ad-hoc YAML scenario files) living in separate repos and teams. This fragmentation causes: flaky perf regressions, duplicated maintenance when model shapes or runtime flags change, and inconsistent CI smoke coverage. Goal: consolidate synthetic profiles into a single canonical repository and introduce a traffic snapshot replayer that can deterministically replay production-derived request traces as CI-grade perf scenarios.
proposal: Create a new repo 'perf-profiles' that stores canonical synthetic profiles, canonical input corpora, and a single format for scenario metadata (JSON-lines with meta tags).

Implement a lightweight 'traffic-snapshot-replayer' service (Go) which accepts a compact trace snapshot (timestamps, request payload hash, route) and replays requests against the existing load harness in deterministic time. The replayer will support time scaling and seed-controlled variability.
Migrate existing k6 scripts into the new profile format and provide a one-time translation tool. Deprecate k6-specific CI jobs in favor of harness-native runners where feasible.

Add CI jobs: (1) smoke deterministic replay against a small golden snapshot on every PR, (2) nightly perf regression job against a medium snapshot, (3) weekly full-sweep load run in the perf staging environment.

Upgrade load harness dependencies as part of the migration: tokio/async runtime bump, unify protobuf schema version 3.15 -> 3.20, and update the internal metrics collector client to v2.3. Ensure all upgrades are gated behind canary runs.
Provide a migration guide and automated linter to validate new profiles and trace snapshots before acceptance.
Instrument run outputs to export deterministic run artifacts (seed, snapshot-id, runtime flags) and wire them into the perf dashboard for regression alerts.
acceptance_criteria: Single 'perf-profiles' repo contains all migrated canonical profiles and a README describing format and conventions.
Traffic snapshot replayer can replay a golden snapshot deterministically in CI with a stable seed and produce bit-identical metrics across runs (within noise tolerance).
All critical k6 scenarios have a mapped canonical profile and existing CI k6 jobs either replaced or flagged for removal.
Nightly regression runs complete end-to-end and produce dashboardable artifacts (latency histograms, p50/p95/p99, CPU/GPU utilization).
No production-facing behavior changes; changes limited to testing harnesses and CI.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Replayer introduces false confidence if snapshots are not representative. Mitigation: curate snapshots from multiple tenants and include synthetic perturbations.
Risk: Dependency upgrades break existing adapters. Mitigation: run canary matrix across 3 representative models and GPU types before flip.
Risk: Increased CI time. Mitigation: tier CI jobs (PR smoke < 5 mins, nightly medium ~ 45 mins, weekly full run scheduled off-hours).
